notes.albums: Fourteen albums: retros (52), windbreaker (7), full zip (7), half zip (3), vest and training set (10), hoodies (8), retro training top R1000 (9), fan version (22), kids sets (4), player versions (13), then a four-garment tail at 23:40.
notes.tailFix: The 23:40 tail was captioned fan version / full zip / half zip / training vest set against five files, which left p664 unassigned in the first alignment. By eye p660 AND p661 are both fan-version shirts, so that album holds 2 photographs, not 1; captions.tsv was corrected and align-0905.mjs now assigns all 664 photographs with zero drift and nothing left over.
notes.multiPhotoGarments: Five garments carry more than one photograph: the 2011 Champions League final pre-match shirt (p537 and p572 are the same shirt shot twice), the purple full-zip tracksuit (p584, p585), the blue floral originals shirt (p657 plus the p658 close-up) and the three retro training tops, each sent as front, back and a composite. The retro training tops are ordered FRONT first so the shop grid does not lead on the back of the garment.
notes.duplicatePhoto: p634 (fan album) and p644 (kids album) are the identical file at dHash distance 0; both are claimed by the 2025/26 home kids kit.
notes.seasonReading: Seasons were read off sponsor, manufacturer and collar: SHARP to 2000, Vodafone 2000-2006, AIG 2006-2010, AON 2010-2014, Chevrolet 2014-2021, TeamViewer 2021-2024, Snapdragon 2024 onward. Where the sponsor era does not pin the year the title carries no season and seasonConfidence is unknown.
notes.liveTitleConflicts: Two live listings look mis-titled and are worth a look: 'Manchester United 1998/99 Third Retro Jersey (Sharp)' shows the black SHARP VIEWCAM shirt, which is 1993/95 (p565 is that same photograph), and 'Manchester United 1994/96 Home Retro Jersey (Sharp)' shows a white-collared Umbro shirt, which is the 1996/98 kit. Neither is changed here.
